notes: ACCESS: Akamai WAF blocks direct/curl_cffi requests to any nykaafashion.com page beyond robots.txt/homepage (403 Access Denied on category pages with all curl_cffi impersonation profiles tried: chrome124/131/120/116/safari17_0/edge101/chrome110/chrome99/safari15_5). robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi chrome124, HTTP 200) has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow -- generic 'User-agent: *' with only /ndsxadm/, /catalogsearch/, /widget-listing/, /all-reviews, /gateway-api/, /rest/appapi/V2/ blocked, none of which were needed. Per Rule 2, routed via translate.goog (https://www-nykaafashion-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=hi&_x_tr_hl=en + curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation), which returned HTTP 200 consistently (occasional 429s handled with backoff/retry). r.jina.ai was tried first but is itself behind a Cloudflare challenge page for this target, so translate.goog was the working route for every fetch in this extraction. CATEGORY TREE SOURCE: every React/Redux SSR page embeds a __PRELOADED_STATE__ JSON script tag; listingV2.filters[category_filter].values holds the FULL Home-department category tree with an explicit productCount per node (id, parent_id, name, productCount, children[]) -- this is the site's own live facet count used to render the filter UI, sourced from the main Home department listing page https://www.nykaafashion.com/home/c/8528. Discovered that the site resolves any listing URL purely by its trailing /c/<id> segment regardless of the slug prefix (confirmed: /xyz/c/8599 and /home/decor/mirrors/c/8599 both return identical Mirrors listing with the canonical categoryURL echoed back in listingV2.categoryURL) -- used this to fetch every in-scope leaf category individually (103 categories) via /x/c/<id>, reading listingV2.count (the category's own dedicated listing count) and listingV2.categoryURL (canonical link) as a second, independent signal against the tree's productCount. All 103 leaves matched exactly or within trivial live-inventory drift (<=1%, e.g. Glassware 1512 vs 1517, Soap Dish & Dispenser 489 vs 490, a few minutes apart) -- the fresher per-category page count was used as qty in every case. No null/MANUAL REVIEW rows were needed; this facet-count mechanism is a direct database count (not a rounded/capped marketplace widget), so Rule 1's exhaustion-check is satisfied by the dual-signal agreement instead. SCOPE: Home vertical only (nykaafashion.com/home/c/8528), Fashion/Beauty verticals not touched. Full Home department tree = Decor (40989), Kitchen & Dining (22558), Bedding (20461), Bath (6895), Storage (5111), Home Essentials (1014), Appliances (332). EXCLUDED WHOLESALE: Bedding, Storage, Home Essentials, Appliances (all furniture/textile/appliance/hardware); within Decor: Accent Furniture (furniture), Curtains & Blinds incl. its Curtain Accessories child (title-checked: genuine mix of decorative metal curtain rods/tiebacks AND actual fabric curtains on one URL with no separable count -- mixed roll-up, dropped per 'drop don't pad'), Floor Coverings (textile rugs/mats), Candles & Home Fragrances in full incl. the 'Candles' node itself (title-checked: predominantly scented -- Mustard Oud Pillar Candle, Fragranced Candle, Scented Votive, etc. -- mixed with the occasional unscented item and no separate unscented-only URL, dropped per Home Fragrance rule), Artificial Flora (faux plants), Festive Decor (Xmas/Valentine/Diwali/Easter/Party -- Holiday & Gift), Natural Greens (title-checked: genuine LIVE plants -- Lucky Bamboo, Money Plant, ZZ Plant -- horticulture, not manufactured decor), Magnets (novelty/gift, not a scope category), Wallpapers and Memo Boards (children of Wall Decor); within Kitchen & Dining: Table & Kitchen Linen (textile), Cutlery, Cookware, Food Prep, Bar Essentials, Bakeware, Gas Stove (all explicitly excluded kitchen tools/appliances/cutlery/bar tools); within Drinkware only Glassware was kept, its siblings Tea & Coffee/Bottles & Flasks/Bottles/Flasks & Insulated Tumblers/Jugs/Drink Accessories/Water Dispensers dropped as functional drinkware, not glassware; within Pooja Essentials, Pooja Needs was title-checked and found to mix genuine decorative diyas/oil lamps with actual ritual consumables (e.g. Pavitra Hawan Samagri) -- dropped as a mixed roll-up, while its sibling Religious Idols (pure figurines, no consumables) was kept; Pooja Chowki (furniture) and Incense Stick Holders (fragrance-adjacent) dropped; within Bath, only Bath Accessories & Utilities' decorative children were kept (Soap Dish & Dispenser, Bathroom Accessories Set, Toothbrush Holder, Tissue Holder -- title-checked, dominated by resin/ceramic/stone decorative sets) while its siblings Laundry Basket (storage), Toiler Brush & Holder (fixture/cleaning), Bath Caddy & Shower Caddy (storage), Shower Holder (plumbing fixture) were dropped, and the Bath department's Towels/Bath Mats/Bath Robes/Shower Curtains (all textile) were dropped outright. RULE 0 GAINS: Wall Murals (title-checked: actually framed/unframed wall-art posters and carved corbels, not literal adhesive photo-murals -- kept as wall art despite the 'mural' name) and Wall Stickers (title-checked: wooden wall plaques, wind chimes, decorative wall-art frames, not wallpaper-style decals -- kept as decorative wall pieces) both survived product-type inspection under Rule 0/mixed-roll-up scrutiny where the name alone would suggest exclusion. Shelves & Ledges (title-checked: small decorative wall-mounted floating shelves explicitly marketed 'for wall decor', not bulky storage furniture) kept as decorative wood wall shelving. Bathroom Mirror kept alongside Wall/Table/Decorative/Dressing Mirror per the explicit 'ALL mirrors in scope' rule (Bathroom is not a blanket exclusion). Table Top Accents > Gift Set (20, decor-item bundles e.g. photo-frame-and-candle-holder sets, vase-and-coaster sets -- no occasion/holiday theming) kept as decorative accessories, distinguished from the excluded Holiday & Gift department. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: no prior Nykaa Fashion / nykaafashion.com entry found among the 260+ already-archived c*.json files in the scratchpad; this is a first extraction for S.N. 282.
